name: Petalburg City
lines:
Being able to attack before an opponent...
That confers a great advantage in battle,
wouldn’t you agree?

Now move on to the next room, where you
will find a new challenge awaiting you.
At the left is the Zero Reduction Room.
The right door leads to the Defense Room.

No matter whom you defeat or who defeats you,
you must never shirk training your Pokémon and yourself.
That’s what it means to be a Gym Leader.
